propositions: Jira Data Center rate limiting (8.6+, DC-only, off-by-default) returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After header, but rebar's transport does not retry it, causing hard failures on rate-limited requests

429 responses must be retried only on idempotent reads (four specific call sites: get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map's paged search, get_comment_map's per-issue fetch, get_parent_map) and never on mutations to avoid duplicates when the server has already begun the write

The retry logic must reuse the existing parse_retry_after() parser and MAX_BACKOFF_S constant from _errors, apply Atlassian's prescribed jitter (up to 20%) to the Retry-After value, and clamp the result to MAX_BACKOFF_S before sleeping

The rate_limit_retry opt-in flag must be threaded through two distinct paths: PATH A via _call_logged for _paged_search callers, and PATH B as a direct parameter to _with_connection_retry for get_comment_map's per-issue fetch which bypasses _call_logged
The flag must default to False on _with_connection_retry, _call_logged, and _paged_search to prevent future mutations from inheriting retry behavior by omission

Cap exhaustion must raise BackendHTTPError with code 429 (never the vendor JIRAError type) by reading Retry-After from exc.response.headers (not exc.headers) which is where JIRAError stores response headers
